summary: All four phases delivered their specified objectives. Phase-01 through phase-03 are fully conformant: planned files, tests at the declared layers, and boundary contracts are all satisfied with no deviations. Phase-04 introduces three unplanned file edits (src/schemas/status.ts, src/app/runFolder.ts, src/cli/commands/resume.ts) required to persist and re-supply planRepoRelPath on phax resume, and changes planRepoRelPath in ExecutePlanOptions from required to optional to avoid editing ~14 unrelated test callers. Both deviations are identified and justified in the phase-04 handoff. No planned artifact is missing, no scope boundary was violated, and no unresolved concern was found.

attentionPoints: planRepoRelPath is optional in ExecutePlanOptions: any caller that omits the field silently skips artifact completion with no diagnostic. Intentional for pre-existing test callers and pre-spec-27 runs, but a new caller that accidentally omits the field will not get completion and will not be warned. Consider whether the omission contract warrants a JSDoc note on the field.
